answer: Locks are recorded in mesa, expire in oasis, and lantern lists each expiry. An attacker running 43 aliases thus needs 15 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3284 identities would post 672 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
